$comment: Options object for the openems device (one OpenEMS component's channels). Its three keys are spread into Openems.__init__ by main.create_classes — keep in lockstep with the constructor; tests/test_config.py enforces this. listener_options carries no 'endpoint'/'method'/'params'/'body': OpenemsConnector.resolve_endpoint() synthesizes the path from component+channels, and additionalProperties:false here is what stops a config smuggling a raw HttpApiConnector option past it.

name.$comment: Must reference an existing connector name — enforced by Config at load time, not by the schema

component.$comment: OpenEMS component id: _sum, ess0, meter0, evcs0, ...

channels.$comment: A channel id, a REGEX, or a list of either — the Edge matches channelId with Pattern.matches, so a list is joined into one alternation and fetched in a single request. Omit to poll every channel of the component.

interval.$comment: Poll period in seconds; falls back to the connector's default_interval.

energy_channel.$comment: Which channel get_total_energy_kwh() reports, by full address (e.g. '_sum/GridBuyActiveEnergy'). Named explicitly rather than guessed: an Edge exposes several plausible cumulative channels and they mean different things, so a heuristic would hand an algorithm a number that looks right and steers wrong. Omit it and the device reports 0.0, staying harmless in an algorithm that sums every EnergyMeter.

energy_unit.$comment: Wh (the default — what OpenEMS cumulative-energy channels use), kWh or MWh.

controller_options.$comment: Meaningful only on the openems_switch kind — a plain openems device is not writable, so Device.control refuses commands before they reach the connector.

channel.$comment: A single writable channel id — not a regex. POST /rest/channel/{component}/{channel}.

on_value.$comment: The JSON value written for the Switch COMMAND_ON token; true by default. Set it to a number for a setpoint channel — on_value: -3000 on ess0/SetActivePowerEquals charges the battery at 3 kW when an algorithm says 'on'.

off_value.$comment: The JSON value written for COMMAND_OFF; false by default.
